visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a 2D ink wash style animation depicting a traditional landscape. Misty blue and green mountains tower over a calm river where a lone fisherman in a conical hat steers a small black boat. A flock of birds flies across the pale sky. (2) The scene cuts to live-action footage of an elderly Asian man with short gray hair lying in a bed with blue linens. He appears to be in significant pain, grimacing with tightly shut eyes and clutching his shoulder, set in a dimly lit indoor bedroom environment. (3) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a wooden calligraphy brush, dipping it into ink and writing traditional Chinese characters on white paper. The lighting is focused and bright on the writing surface. (4) The camera shows a series of close-ups of the completed calligraphy work, with black ink characters flowing across the white paper in a traditional script. (5) The video concludes with a graphic background featuring a yellow-toned screen with a purple snake icon. Large black text overlays are centered on the screen, accompanied by smaller reference text and slogans that change periodically.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video is a public health service advertisement or educational campaign designed to raise awareness about 'Pise' (Shingles/Herpes Zoster). It uses a creative wordplay on the name of the historical figure Oda Nobunaga (枝填信長) to tell a story about the pain and suffering caused by the disease, eventually leading to a recommendation for viewers to seek professional medical advice and prevention.
